reasons: gained members ["'go_release_2024-01-17': 'an ontology release, not a genome; the go.obo the S288C genome class reads'"]

correctness_argument: The genome registry gained the set id go_release_2024-01-17 in PR #1192: the dated go.obo (sha256 ad2f0502...aa9ff, 34,420,328 bytes) that the S288C genome class reads, deposited so that a new machine reads the same ontology as every existing one. The vocabulary test requires every registry set id to be placed either in AssemblySet (an assembly a record pins) or in NON_ASSEMBLY_REGISTRY_SETS (with its reason), and PR #1192 placed it in neither, so the test has failed on main since 68d93d74a. An ontology release is not an assembly: no record's identifiers are written against it and no ASSEMBLY_SET_ACCESSIONS entry could exist for it. It therefore belongs in NON_ASSEMBLY_REGISTRY_SETS beside go_release_2026-08-05, which is there for the same reason. AssemblySet, and so every record field typed by it, is unchanged; no stored record serializes differently.

alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: A record would then be allowed to pin an ontology file as its genome assembly, and ASSEMBLY_SET_ACCESSIONS requires a GCA_ accession it cannot have.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Exclude the constant by name in the vocabulary test.
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: The test's exclusion list is for registry constants that are not set ids; this one is a deposited set, and the mapping exists so each such set is placed in writing with its reason.
